name: LIT final (2026)
status: live strategy since 2026-10-18 (paper only): live_model.json model lit, engine/lit_live.py; check tests/test_lit_live.py
how_to_run: from tools import lit_final as F; T = F.run(F.final_params())  # engine/lit.py run_x
selection: picked on 2026 H1 (Jan 2 - Jun 30) by H1 net without its 3 best trades (so one lucky trade cannot pick the strategy), checked on 2026 H2 (Jul 1 - Oct 16); two settings that changed neither half by more than $0.5k were set back to the simpler lit_A value; 2021-25 reference only

tested in the merge and not used: sessions sweep set (B1N) + Mon-Wed rule (sessions study)
HOW-window half size how_out 0.5 (filters study; kept as the eval-safe option)

explain.ref: structure shift = 5m CISD: first 5m close beyond the open of the last run of opposite-close bars into the sweep extreme
explain.sweep_names: null = every level counts (Asia/London/NY boxes, premarket, PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, PMH/PML, NWOG/NDOG edges, build-ups)
explain.disp: biggest candle body between the extreme and the trigger >= 0.8 x ATR(14, 5m)
explain.depth: sweep extreme >= 0.5 ATR beyond the nearest swept level
explain.idm_a: [1.0, 36, 1]: at least 1 5m swing low (high for shorts) within 1.0 ATR beyond the swept level, formed <= 36 bars before the sweep, untouched until the final run into the extreme took it
explain.wait: the limit at the CISD level is valid for 6 five-minute bars (30 min)
explain.cisd1m: after the tap, up to 20 one-minute bars for a 1m CISD close, then enter at the next 1m open + 1 tick (before 2026, no 1m data: 4 five-minute bars)
explain.tf: 2026 days with full 1m coverage are filled and managed on true 1m bars
explain.stop_buf: stop 0.25 pt (1 tick) beyond the 5m sweep extreme
explain.min_stop/max_stop: stop 8-80 pts from the planned limit price, else no trade (size follows the real stop at the fill)
explain.classes/vix_k: target = 18:00 open +/- 1.0 x VIX one-day move (prior VIX close / 100 / sqrt(252) x 18:00 open), on the trade's side
explain.min_rr/max_rr/fallback_rr: target must be >= 1.5R from the real fill, capped (banked) at 8R; no band target >= 1.5R away -> no trade (fallback_rr null)
explain.be_r: stop to breakeven once +1R is reached
explain.size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800x20/stop; MNQ $2/pt; max 40 micros; floor: no trade if < 1 micro
explain.costs: $1.40 per micro round trip; 1 tick slippage on market entries and on stop / breakeven / end-of-day exits (limit entries and targets fill at the price)

eval_safe_option.what: half size when the sweep extreme is outside Tue 03:00 - Wed 11:30 ET; 2026 +$27.8k (PF 3.17) instead of +$38.9k, max DD -$2.3k instead of -$3.1k, no eval failed within 2 weeks, pass rate 86% instead of 80%
